summary: Review rate limiting and quota enforcement for identity keys, distributed consistency, bypass paths, burst semantics and failure behavior.

must_inspect.why: The limiter key must correspond to the abuse or fairness boundary being protected.
false_positive_guards: Do not assume IP-only limiting is wrong when protecting an unauthenticated edge.

must_inspect.why: Multiple workers/regions can make local counters ineffective for a global policy.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand global consistency if the policy is intentionally per-instance or per-region.

must_inspect.why: Limiter backend failure behavior should be intentional for the protected operation.
false_positive_guards: The correct failure mode depends on safety/availability tradeoffs; do not impose one universally.
